mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a reduction in liquidity and higher borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which can boost related industries and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down and industrial production (INDPRO) declines, it indicates a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY and INDPRO declines > 1%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY and INDPRO declines > 1%.
